entries.title: Add project-control registries
entries.description: Checkpoints, discoveries, compatibility, milestones, decisions, and changelog records were added beside the existing task registry. RO-001 through RO-028 were kept. No feature was marked compatible with original RoS.

entries.title: Record the Phase 00 baseline
entries.description: Specialist audits and the baseline report were added. Pytest returned 1 failed, 64 passed, 1 skipped. No server module was changed and no feature was marked compatible.

entries.title: Enforce stored sessions on HTTP and WebSocket
entries.description: Logout revokes the presented session hash. Both entry points reject a missing, revoked, or expired row. New tokens include a unique jti. Argon2 and JWT expiration checks are unchanged.
tests: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/integration/test_auth_session.py tests/integration/test_auth.py tests/integration/test_lobby_routes.py tests/integration/test_health.py tests/integration/test_websocket.py tests/integration/test_websocket_reliability.py tests/security/test_responses.py -q --tb=line

entries.title: Stop the Locust run from blocking on unread server output
entries.description: The load test writes the server log to a file and the client reports auth success, rejection, or the existing 3 second timeout. The rerun passed.

entries.title: Add durable lobby leave, ready, and database readiness
entries.description: Members can leave a durable lobby and set ready or unready. GET /health stays {status: ok}. GET /ready checks the database. Original lobby behavior stays unknown.
tests: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/integration/test_auth_session.py tests/integration/test_auth.py tests/integration/test_lobby_routes.py tests/integration/test_health.py tests/integration/test_websocket.py tests/integration/test_websocket_reliability.py tests/security/test_responses.py -q --tb=line

entries.title: Add durable inventory, team leave, and stored match lifecycle
entries.description: Authenticated players can change stored stacks and currency, leave a team without leaving the lobby, and create, cancel, or finalize a stored match. Live matches stay on /matches. No original reward values were added.

entries.title: Add a local buggy without changing on-foot combat
entries.description: A player can board a development buggy and move at speed 12. Shooting is rejected until exit. On-foot speed stays 5. Results still record placement and kills only.
tests: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/unit/test_simulation.py tests/compatibility/gameplay tests/compatibility/weapons tests/compatibility/match_results tests/unit/test_protocol.py -q --tb=short

entries.title: Record the client research boundary
entries.description: Research pages now separate this server's JSON contract from original behavior. A public search found no authorized protocol. The parser is tested against the documented message and action names.

entries.title: Refresh the short load sample and the release status
entries.description: The Locust profile passed again with 77 requests and 0 failures. The baseline now cites that row. Release remains blocked: Docker returned an engine error and PostgreSQL was not executed.

entries.title: Sync specialist jobs with the task registry
entries.description: Each specialist row now names a rule file beside its skills. Role files point at that rule and at tasks.json. Open task paths were brought inside allowed_paths. Eligible backlog tasks moved to ready. RO-055 stays in review.

entries.title: Record the database security review
entries.description: RO-009 is completed from docs/engineering/reviews/RO-009-security.md. The review approves account storage, session hashes, response schemas, and the legacy upgrade. Three medium follow-ups remain. RO-029 and RO-032 stay in review.

entries.title: Close reviewed movement, protocol, and registry tasks
entries.description: QA approved RO-029, RO-032, RO-012, and RO-055. The security engineer approved RO-032. The CTO re-ran the cited tests and recorded completion. RO-016 and RO-030 are ready. RO-035 stays in review.

entries.title: Align the compatibility registry with the matrix
entries.description: Eight drifted rows in the management compatibility registry now match the reference matrix. Every compatibility status stays unknown. RO-016 is completed.

entries.title: Plan the original-client match integration
entries.description: Gap review of the in-match gateway (doors, loot, bots, countdown, plane, jump, zone) and 18 tasks RO-056 to RO-073 in phase 09. No source file changed. team.json gained bigworld_gateway allowed paths for five specialists.

entries.title: Plan door, loot quantity, discard, glass, action and equip work for the original client
entries.description: Thirteen tasks RO-074 to RO-086 in phase 09: door and element research (RO-074) and coverage (RO-075), item quantity and equip research (RO-076) with loot stacks (RO-077) and equip (RO-084), bag discard research (RO-078) and module (RO-079), breakable glass research (RO-080) and module (RO-081), character action research (RO-082) and module (RO-083), QA (RO-085) and security review (RO-086). RO-067 now also depends on RO-074. No source file changed.
